description: This file defines types, policies, and functions related to hook management and resolution in the openclaw project, including hook source policies, enable states, collision resolution, and configuration resolution.

methods.name: getHookSourcePolicy
methods.description: Returns the policy object for a given hook source.

methods.name: resolveHookConfig
methods.description: Resolves and returns the hook configuration for a given hook key from the provided OpenClawConfig.

methods.name: resolveHookEnableState
methods.description: Determines whether a hook entry is enabled based on its source, configuration, and default policies.

methods.name: resolveHookEntries
methods.description: Resolves and merges hook entries, handling collisions based on source precedence and override rules.
